definitions: Something that reflects the current state of society or common trends.
An indication of how things are changing or developing in the world.
A characteristic event or situation that reveals the nature of the present era.
examples: More people working from home, it's a sign of the times.
The rise of online shopping, it's a sign of the times.
Kids learning to code at a young age, it's a sign of the times.
lemma: it's a sign of the times
source: it's a sign of the times
